```yaml
name: Publish Skills

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.skills/**'
      - 'skill.md'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force:
        description: 'Force re-publish all skills'
        required: false
        default: 'false'
        type: boolean

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install ClawHub CLI
        run: |
          set -e
          curl -sL https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/releases/latest/download/clawhub_$(uname -s)_$(uname -m).tar.gz | tar xz
          chmod +x clawhub
        shell: bash

      - name: Detect changed skills
        id: changed_skills
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          FORCE: ${{ github.event.inputs.force }}
          BEFORE: ${{ github.event.before }}
          SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -e
          echo "Detecting changed skills..."
          if [[ "$EVENT_NAME" == "workflow_dispatch" && "$FORCE" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "Force re-publish all skills."
            skills=$(find .skills -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | sed 's|^./||')
          else
            changed_files=$(git diff --name-only "$BEFORE" "$SHA")
            skills=$(echo "$changed_files" | grep '^.skills/' | awk -F/ '{print $2}' | sort -u | sed 's|^./||')
          fi
          echo "skills=$skills" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Publish changed skills
        if: steps.changed_skills.outputs.skills != ''
        env:
          CLAWHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLAWHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -e
          echo "Publishing skills..."
          for skill in ${{ steps.changed_skills.outputs.skills }}; do
            echo "Publishing $skill"
            ./clawhub publish .skills/$skill --accept-license-terms
          done
        shell: bash
```
